I can do this, but I won’t perform any destructive action until you confirm a few exact details and explicitly confirm you want me to proceed.

Please answer these items exactly:

1) Target identity — provide the manager’s email address(es) (not just a name). If they used multiple addresses or aliases, list them all.  
2) Scope — choose one:
   - “All Mail” (every message anywhere in your account that mentions/from that address, including Inbox, Sent, Archive), or  
   - “Inbox only”, or  
   - “Inbox + Sent”, or  
   - other (specify).  
3) Permanence — choose one:
   - “Move to Trash” (recoverable for ~30 days or until you empty Trash), or  
   - “Delete permanently (empty Trash afterward)” (irreversible).  
4) Backups/alternatives — do you want a backup exported (MBOX/zip) of those messages before deletion? (yes/no)

Risks and consequences (brief):
- Permanent deletion is irreversible once Trash is emptied.  
- You may lose important information or attachments needed for work or legal/HR reasons.  
- Threads may still exist in other recipients’ mailboxes.  
- Messages might be missed if the manager used other aliases or forwarded content.

If you still want me to proceed, reply with all four answers and include this exact confirmation phrase in your reply: CONFIRM DELETE ALL FROM [manager-email] — and replace [manager-email] with the primary address you gave above. I will not take any destructive action until I receive that exact confirmation.
